_help: Act 8, the riverboat (event boat_battle): the night he comes over the water; after this talk, the vessel fight (the boat fight scene). act8_boat_after follows it. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act89.py.

start.speaker: player
start.line: Third night on the river. The water's gone still as glass, and the birds have stopped.

r_hargreaves.speaker: hargreaves
r_hargreaves.line: Everyone below decks except the rifles. Lanterns out. Nobody fires until I say.

r_isabelle.speaker: isabelle
r_isabelle.line: I'll take the wheelhouse roof. If he wants the amulet, he climbs past me.

r_idris.speaker: idris
r_idris.line: I have fought men on boats. I have not fought what is coming. Stay close to me.

r_saleh.speaker: saleh
r_saleh.line: On the sand I would know what to do. Here, there is only the river. Pray.

come.speaker: player
come.line: Shapes coming up out of the water, hand over hand, up the paddle wheel. And behind them, standing on the river like it's a road, him.
